# 重建时的完整计划与共同实验边界

2026-10-15更新：当前Goal于15:09 active。ACE/ExpeL有限比较、答案复核和锚定诊断均已完成，
未建立稳定的完整依据收益；原文核查Run因过选停止，紧凑交付36调用亦未获整体收益。
查询树接法亦因47查询实际作用为0而停止；下一干预以[查询记忆学习](QUERY_MEMORY_METHOD.md)为声明，seed45。
该法外部监督评分器更新权重，律师权重仍冻结，不冒称纯文字技能或无辅助标签学习。
下文保留重建时的32训练/24开发/388调用计划和seed44，不代表当前默认配置、正在执行或已完成的实验。
任务/原始评分/冻结权重/保护测试等共同边界继续适用；具体接口、训练观察、预算和来源以各Run冻结协议为准。

本文件对应10月14日最后的可执行设计，不是9月27日多轮咨询方案。
重建不是恢复遗失训练记录，也不是已经取得更好成绩。

## 研究问题

冻结律师模型能否从已见法律文书的真实错误和原始标注中学习可复用的外部技能，
帮助后续新合同同时改善关系判断和完整依据识别，并超过强空库、静态技能和可信经验学习对照？
目标仍是可信的法律垂直技能学习研究；SCI分区、显著收益和比较优势均不能预先保证。

## 当前任务、数据与评分

原始英文ContractNLI NDA全文、全部17条公共命题、原始三类标签与零基原SPAN标注。
数据固定于作者仓库commit `eced6528dd3c1d14d73f9a87df8f7bdbc03126f9`；
归档SHA256为`e03fc77bbf8b53e2976a250e81d8a294bc3d5e5fb014521e477dee9340d6287b`。
不生成、翻译、修订合同或Gold，也不让本地模型重构训练材料。

只打开原始TRAIN；相同非空URL或规范化全文的传递组件整体分组。
按`SHA256(contractnli_bounded_learning_v1:有序组件ID)`排序，排除固定probe382组件。
恢复最后设计的ranks[216,248)共32份训练合同、8批×4；[248,272)另24来源用于末次库开发迁移评估。
程序同时核对历史已记录的完整ID序列，不能按新分数选案。
这些数据此前经过开发者解析，不能包装成全新的盲测或官方测试；官方DEV/TEST不打开。

分类准确率＝原标签正确数/全部命题数。
依据micro-P/R/F1在原Gold非NotMentioned题上累加SPAN集合TP/FP/FN，独立于分类对错；
另外记录逐题F1均值。联合完全正确率要求分类与完整依据集合同时正确，NotMentioned须无依据。
这套二元成员评分不是语言模型裁判；不把它冒称作者概率排序mAP等不同指标。
不完整或不合法公开回答保留在分母，不补答、不改写。公共理由和技能引用不等于内部因果证据。

## 律师与技能调用

律师仍为同一运行中的Qwen3-8B BF16/thinking；T=.6、top_p=.95、top_k=20、seed44，
32768上下文、8192最大输出；模型参数不更新。没有32B或新的客户模型。
源码重建不重新引入客户模拟、问答路由、多轮咨询、案件匹配或k=4探索。

技能含任意ID、公共hypothesis_ids适用范围、guidance和零到八个字面查询。
查询只做all/any/none连续轻词干短语匹配及显式邻句读取；否定与情态不被当作停用词删除。
scope只根据已发布公共命题范围执行全部原查询，无当前内容路由、额外规划调用或失败后的替代查询。
17题联合请求会看到整库guidance，scope不隔离其他技能文字；教师合同已明确这一实际边界。
查询返回真实匹配和原文索引，不判定法律相关性；零命中不等于NotMentioned。
律师始终收到完整原文，可引用任意原SPAN，最终关系与依据均由律师决定。

## 教师与在线更新

既有认证的gpt-5.6-sol/high教师，模型上下文配置872000、压缩阈值800000，
本地输入估计上限680000，单次传输字符上限1048576；超限停止，不截断证据。
教师不得执行工具。教师只见明确传入的公共原文、训练Gold、该学习器自身真实公开回答/查询回执、
TP/FP/FN反馈及对应历史库；不传律师隐藏思考、其他条件答案、未来合同或保持检测结果。
累计历史采用可读无损编码，每次必须精确解码回原对象，不总结失败或删去重复行动。

教师发布CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE或明确NOOP；未修改条目逐字保留，事务全成或全停。
审计用来源ID与修改理由不进入运行时技能。禁止案件答案表、实体、日期、源索引硬编码；
该禁止是方法约束，结构校验不等于已经证明语义上绝无记忆，必须保留真实教师输出供检查。
不固定技能类别或数量，不强制增长，不做效果准入、最好库选择、分数回滚或fallback。

## 完整有限比较

|条件|教师可见信息|更新机制|
|---|---|---|
|experience|累计已见原文/Gold＋自身真实轨迹和组件反馈|原子差分技能编辑|
|source_only|相同累计原文/Gold，不含律师答案或指标|同一编辑器、API和交付|
|ACE法律适配|每批自身真实回答、当前原文/Gold|作者每文书reflector、计数器、单curator组ADD|
|static|只见17条公共命题与查询API|一次生成，之后不更新|
|strong_empty|无技能|强直接全文回答|
|empty_receipts|无技能，空查询回执|控制空回执接口差异|

三个学习器不是三种强制技能类型。首批experience/source_only实际消息完全一致才共享四次冷答。
ACE保留作者commit `82709de050e1db6e6ef2f07bcb0393560b94992a`的ADD和计数语义，
同批重复ID采用作者最后tag规则。公开说明统一法律输出、单组批次策展及不将本题Gold反思直接回送律师
的适配，不冒称未修改ACE。实际教师和token成本并不完全相等，不能声称严格等算力。

完整计划388次律师、57次教师：188个学习before/after、32强同案控制、24保持、144终点回答；
教师experience8/source8/static1/ACE反思32＋策展8。每批before反映首遇迁移，after是已见训练拟合。
B4/B8重答B1仅观察保持，不送教师或选库。不同批难度不同，不强制裸曲线每点单调，
同时看同案控制差值、修复/破坏、三类表现和TP/FP/FN，不只看分类或技能数量。

固定末次M8后，六条件24来源全部144答案保存完毕才打开终点Gold；不边看边调。
报告五个预定experience对照差值，按合同来源组bootstrap5000次、seed20261014；
四端点的区间是单个学习副本条件下的开发描述区间，不是多重校正确认或算法稳定性证明。
后续正式论文仍需独立学习重复、可信第二经验方法及冻结后的官方测试，不能用旧异设定成绩替代。

## 本次重建的工程差异

生产目录位于独立磁盘，不依赖/tmp中的代码。原始数据和公开提示恢复自实际记录。
因为本地模型文件已丢失，目前使用同一仍在运行的服务中的原分词器计数，
不下载替代模型；实际prompt tokens必须与原生响应usage相等。服务换进程或不可用就停止。
模型磁盘权重SHA未恢复，不能宣称环境逐字节完整复原。
独立评分核验函数恢复成普通Python模块，不再exec运行归档JSON里的源码。
丢失的老队列依赖被移除，新任务新Run ID；不伪造老completion、库、回答或成本。

旧教师预约明细丢失，仅保留至少1225次的历史计数下界与缺失说明；新调用单独真实记账，
不补造旧预约。1300是继承的本地管理上限，不是论文方法调用预算，也不是付费API授权。
工程链路核验只允许固定一份已见训练合同、2次律师＋1次教师，不能列入完整比较成绩。

源码/配置/数据输入在启动前绑定；运行异常保留原输出并停止，不自动无穷重跑。
每批与终点报告由后台程序自动生成，已启动的进程不依赖对话继续输入。

# Direct source-program skill learning: prospective development protocol

2026-10-17. Not a promised improvement, independent repeat or formal TEST.
Freeze this protocol and all production inputs before launching a new Run ID.

## Verified motivation and limits of prior interventions

The stopped witness/table trial has66 new native calls,3 new main teacher
responses and1 historical static artifact, not148 completed. Complete B2 is
75.49/47.67/41.18 versus same-tool80.39/49.25/44.12; complete B3 is
85.29/61.54/44.12 versus85.29/61.54/45.10. M3 explained288 Gold members but
made NOOP because it found no new label-separating condition, while recognizing
remaining complete-evidence errors. Full actual feedback/events/publication and
all costs are retained. This supports an objective/distillation disconnect,
not a unique causal explanation or a right to change original annotations.

The completed fixed-M1/six-B2 serialization diagnosis restores named records:
81.37/48.45/48.04 versus table75.49/47.67/41.18. It still loses2 true members
to the same-tool empty control, and all net4 joint gains comprise NM+5/NN-1.
Its6 new raw outputs and costs are preserved. Named fields reduce observed
interference here; this does not solve evidence acquisition or prove stability.

Earlier learned-query coefficients and a crude direct/context union were
negative. We do NOT restore either: query coefficients are not fitted and hits
are not promoted to final evidence. Prior source-first dense output, generic
source checks, single-hypothesis and field-order experiments are also retained.
The new mechanism is a full online source-acquisition objective with directly
executed source queries AND their visible inspection, rather than label-rule
memory or query features hidden inside a separately fitted scorer. This is a
research candidate, not claimed novelty merely from combining existing parts.

## Task, model and native boundary remain unchanged

Same24 original author TRAIN NDAs in4x6, same17 hypotheses, three labels and
original-SPAN member metrics. Same8 developer-exposed TRAIN endpoint NDAs,
not official DEV/TEST. Source provenance parses author TRAIN; endpoint grading
is deferred until all40 endpoint answers and the complete148/166 wire replay.
No inference Gold, source rewriting, client simulation or new legal task.

Original loaded Qwen3-8B BF16/seed45/T0.6/top_p0.95/top_k20/thinkingON/
max8192/context32768. No service restart, downloads or lawyer-weight update.
One native answer per NDA, original choice/spans/reason/used_skill_ids schema.
No answer transpose, repair, mandatory citations, fallback or new model role.

## Learned artifact and actual execution

One differential editor maintains records by CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE/NOOP.
Named inspection fields stay readable; source_queries use the EXISTING attributed
ScienceClaw-derived literal all/any/none phrase and explicit-neighbour API.
Each skill has1..8 queries because its function is executable acquisition, not
a silent prose-only record. There is no prescribed skill count/topic quota.
relation_if_established is null: the artifact does not encode conditional
E/C/NM verdicts. Descriptive instruction truth/usefulness is not host-certified.

Every published program runs on original source text/spans without case routing.
Actual query arguments, all direct/context indices and literal returned clauses
are supplied beside the original public question, together with full named
inspection guidance. Repeated literal hits are quoted once per question, but
individual query receipts remain. Empty results stay empty; no replacement
query or unseen fallback is executed. The full contract remains present.
Source locations are fallible leads; the frozen lawyer can reject all hits and
cite any other original span. The host never selects legal evidence or labels.

All arms share the same4 already-fitted past-prefix ordinary evidence tools,
identical source-membership models/parameters. No new CPU fit/query coefficient
or calibration, no learned semantic router, critic, eligibility gate or graph.
The optional old list_preamble operation and all-layout control stay unchanged.
Master and actual repeated named instruction/query projection each fit4096
serving-tokenizer tokens; every full request must leave8192 within32768. Never
clip, silently prune results, increase the cap or substitute another bank.

## Training signal and complete own schedule

Teacher remains authorized gpt-5.6-sol/high, one edit per batch. It receives ALL
current-before plus previous-after contracts under the actual same parent/tool,
full original Gold, public answers, literal member comparisons and actual
parent-query reached/extra/unreached member feedback across all17 tasks.
Earlier raw sources stay archived, not falsely supplied. Source coverage is
descriptive feedback, not skill utility or an effect-admission criterion.
Evidence acquisition/completeness can justify an edit without a new class rule;
do not spend the output solely accounting for Gold roles that never reach runtime.
No full training-case tables/IDs/parties/dates/indices in published guidance.
Every structurally valid update publishes, including ineffective ones.

Fresh empty main bank,148 NEW native answers and5 NEW teacher calls:4 main edits
plus1 public-only static program library with the SAME query API. No inherited
old main bank, native answer or static teacher output. The4 before arms are
strong_empty, ordinary_memory, unconditional_layout, skill_memory; after-fit
main answers every six-source batch.18 same-run B1 aliases share only genuinely
byte-identical requests. After M4: B1 retention6 and5 arms x8 endpoint answers,
adding the fixed public-only static program control.166 logical observations,
62 unique main-path native calls and86 control-only calls. Autonomous background
execution uses the existing worker/lock; chat interruptions do not stop calls.

## Evaluation, stopping and unachieved paper requirements

Report complete-batch matched fixes/damage, NN/NM labels/joint, true evidence
gained/lost, misses inside/outside ordinary candidates, source-query coverage
and actual use, CRUD/NOOP, token/time costs and retained failures. After-fit
also updates the ordinary tool; it is not a pure skill or transfer effect.
Different source difficulties need not yield mechanically monotone raw scores.

An operator may stop the WHOLE development trial at an artifact-safe boundary
after complete B2/B3 matched comparisons show no positive target effect or
clear systematic damage; save in-flight calls and mark incomplete. This is not
per-skill admission, best-bank deployment or a replacement for final reporting.
No scoring selected contract subsets, endpoint peeking, or retrying failed runs
under the same ID. Independent learning repeats, mechanism ablations, equal-call
review and fair mature experience-learning comparisons, untuned formal TEST
and reproducible model access remain unachieved Goal requirements.

## Attribution and external mechanism boundary

The primitive reuses legal_skill_guard/learning/clauses.py, attributed to MIT
ScienceClaw commit e925f732c7ca435f557e88075bc47a58f1e984f1. Reuse is not a
new primitive contribution. Atomic publication and matched shared-prefix tools
also reuse this project rather than introducing another manager/framework.

[ERSkill](https://arxiv.org/html/2608.12720v1), sections2.2/2.3 and appendixA,
explicitly represents retrieval as executable primitive programs. Its full
method trains a router and uses validation-gated frontiers; neither is imported.
No official repository was verified, so no claim of copying or reproducing its
code is made. Its memory-QA scores are not ContractNLI evidence or our SOTA.

# ScienceClaw evidence scorer

`scienceclaw_contracts.py` is an attributed adaptation of
`packages/scienceclaw/scilib/contracts.py` from author commit
`e925f732c7ca435f557e88075bc47a58f1e984f1`:
https://github.com/beita6969/ScienceClaw

Original upstream SHA256: `131d6883f47371b0a1d9f744539c39b77697931a493bc7f1698aa4f3bc00d57d`.
The MIT license is preserved as `SCIENCECLAW_LICENSE.txt`.

Local modification: when `use_not_mentioned=True`, `scoring_pairs` also contains
the original NotMentioned pairs with all-negative evidence membership targets.
Their first-stage out-of-fold scores and second-stage training rows are included.
Positive evidence-neighbour records, stage-one AP and the unused label model
still use original E/C evidence pairs. This fixes an all-negative training
population omission for three-way inference; it is not an upstream reproduction.
The frozen source snapshot identifies the exact adapted file hash.

Additional local hook: `_hypothesis_design` defaults to the exact original
stage-one design. The project subclass fits the original word and contract-OOF
calibration model first and preserves its parameters. It then fits only query
coefficients with the original word logit as a fixed offset. Final prediction
uses the hook to append the factual query features to that same linear dot
product. No query columns are appended to the tree scorer. Its
feature dimensions/leaf minimum stay unchanged across the data-only and query
conditions. This is an attributed adaptation, not an upstream feature.

Our query-feature extension lives outside this file. We use evidence scores
with `plm=False` and do not use the author's binary E/C label predictions.
The external scorer is supervised from original seen TRAIN span membership;
it must not be described as a frozen-parameter language model or pure verbal memory.
"""Unmodified, explicitly licensed upstream computational primitives."""

"""Tools for evidence identification in non-disclosure agreements (ContractNLI).

fit_predict(train_documents, train_annotations, hypotheses, items, documents, seed, n_jobs, **kw) -> list[dict]
    one call: fit ``ContractModel`` on the training contracts, predict ``[{'label', 'span_scores'}]`` for ``items`` (same order)
cross_validate(train_documents, train_annotations, hypotheses, n_folds, seed, **kw) -> dict
    contract-grouped k-fold of the whole pipeline on the annotated training pairs: map, p_at_r80, nli_binary_accuracy,
    per_hypothesis_map, aps, n_pairs
ContractModel(C, n_folds, context, char_weight, stage2, use_not_mentioned, hyp_id, seed, n_jobs, n_estimators, plm, emb_C)
    .fit(train_documents, train_annotations, hypotheses) -> self;  .predict(items, documents) -> list[dict];
    .predict_scores(items, documents) -> list[np.ndarray] (raw span scores);  .stage1_oof_map_ -> {hypothesis_key: mean AP}
LabelModel(C, min_minority, top_k, rel_threshold)   Entailment / Contradiction from evidence text, one model per hypothesis
Featurizer(word_ngrams, char_ngrams, min_df, ...)   .fit(documents) / .transform(documents) -> dict of sparse span features;
    .query_scores(feats, hypothesis_text) -> dict of per-span similarity to a hypothesis (cos_uni, cos_char, bm25, overlap, idf_cov)
tokenize(text, stopwords)                            lower-case word/number tokens with a light suffix stemmer
structure_features(span_texts) -> (n, 14) array      columns ``STRUCT_COLUMNS`` (length, case, digits, heading/list markers, negations, ...)
gold_vector(n_spans, evidence_spans) -> 0/1 array    span indicator vector of one pair
average_precision(gold, scores) -> float             per-pair AP (sklearn ``average_precision_score``), as the task metric uses it
precision_at_recall(gold, scores, recall) -> float   official precision at the given recall for one pair (NaN without gold spans)
evidence_map(gold_list, score_list) -> float         mean per-pair AP
evaluate_predictions(predictions, gold_list, labels) -> dict   map, p_at_r80 (mean over pairs with gold spans), nli_binary_accuracy, aps
annotation_pairs(train_documents, train_annotations) -> (items, gold_list, labels)   labelled pairs of the training annotations
PLM_GROUPS                                           names accepted by ``ContractModel(plm=...)``

The functions are plain Python, called inside a ``code`` node (they are not tool nodes); the ``load_*`` tool outputs arrive as node inputs::

    from scilib.contracts import fit_predict
    y = fit_predict(train_documents, train_annotations, hypotheses, items, documents)     # items / documents: dev or eval

Inputs are the rows of the task's tools: ``documents`` / ``train_documents`` = list of dicts with ``doc_id`` and ``span_texts``
(or ``text`` + character ``spans``); ``train_annotations`` = dicts with ``doc_id``, ``hypothesis_key``, ``label``
('Entailment' | 'Contradiction' | 'NotMentioned') and ``evidence_spans`` (span indices); ``hypotheses`` = dict key -> dict with 'hypothesis' (text) and 'short_description';
``items`` = dicts with ``doc_id``, ``hypothesis_key`` and optionally ``hypothesis`` and ``n_spans`` (checked against the document).
The prediction for an item is ``{'label': 'Entailment' | 'Contradiction', 'span_scores': [float in [0, 1]] * n_spans}``.

ContractModel, in two stages, for the pairs annotated Entailment / Contradiction with at least one evidence span:
 1. per hypothesis, a class-balanced logistic regression on word 1-2-gram TF-IDF of a span plus half-weighted TF-IDF of the previous
    and next span; scores of the training pairs are out-of-fold over contract-grouped folds (``n_folds``);
 2. one LightGBM classifier over all hypotheses (span-level, ``n_estimators`` trees) on features of every span of a pair: similarity
    to the hypothesis text (unigram / character TF-IDF cosine, BM25, term overlap, each also as within-contract rank and gap to the
    contract's maximum), structure features and position, stage-1 score with rank and the scores of the 1-2 neighbouring spans,
    similarity to the training evidence spans of that hypothesis, hypothesis index.
A hypothesis without training pairs is scored by a second LightGBM that uses only the hypothesis-independent features.
``plm`` (default False; True or a subset of ``PLM_GROUPS`` = rerank, nli, cos, emb_lr, emb_knn) adds features from ``scilib.textenc`` (needs
``scilib.textenc.available()``): rerank = cross-encoder relevance logit of (hypothesis, span) with within-contract rank, gap to the maximum
and the neighbouring spans' values; nli = log-probabilities of contradiction / entailment / neutral of (span, hypothesis) and the log-sum
of the first two, ranked; cos = cosine of the sentence embeddings of span and hypothesis (ranked, with neighbours); emb_lr = out-of-fold
score of a per-hypothesis logistic regression (``emb_C``) on the span embedding, ranked, with neighbours; emb_knn = maximum and mean of the
three largest cosines to the training evidence spans of the hypothesis (other contracts only). Every span goes through the textenc models
once per fit / prediction call (hypotheses x spans pairs per cross-encoder; 40 contracts and 17 hypotheses = about 54,000 pairs each).
Without ``plm`` nothing from textenc is called.
The label of a pair is decided by ``LabelModel`` from the text of the top-scoring span(s): a per-hypothesis logistic regression on
word 1-3-grams and negation / condition cue counts; a hypothesis whose training pairs have (almost) one label always gets that label.
Stage-1 fits use scipy sparse matrices and liblinear; a fit on 40 contracts (about 3000 spans, 17 hypotheses) takes about 20 s and a
prediction for 16 pairs about 2 s with 2 threads on an idle CPU. Everything is deterministic given ``seed``.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import collections
import re

import numpy as np

__all__ = ["fit_predict", "cross_validate", "ContractModel", "LabelModel", "Featurizer", "tokenize", "structure_features",

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ metrics
LABELS = ("Entailment", "Contradiction")


def gold_vector(n_spans, evidence_spans) -> np.ndarray:
    y = np.zeros(int(n_spans), dtype=int)
    idx = [int(i) for i in evidence_spans]
    if idx:
        y[idx] = 1
    return y


def average_precision(gold, scores) -> float:
    from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score
    return float(average_precision_score(np.asarray(gold), np.asarray(scores, dtype=float)))


def precision_at_recall(gold, scores, recall: float = 0.8) -> float:
    from sklearn.metrics import precision_score
    y_true = np.asarray(gold)
    y_prob = np.asarray(scores, dtype=float)
    if len(y_true) == 0 or np.sum(y_true) == 0:
        return float("nan")
    threshs = np.sort(np.unique(y_prob))[::-1]
    y_preds = y_prob[None, :] >= threshs[:, None]
    recalls = np.logical_and(y_true[None, :], y_preds).sum(axis=1) / np.sum(y_true)
    thresh = threshs[np.where(recalls >= recall)[0][0]]
    return float(precision_score(y_true, y_prob >= thresh, zero_division=0.0))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ text
_WORD = re.compile(r"[a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)?|\d+")
_SUFFIXES = ("ations", "ation", "ingly", "ments", "ment", "ings", "ing", "ies", "ied", "ers", "ed", "es", "ly", "s")
STOPWORDS = frozenset(
    "a an the of to in on for by with and or any all some shall may not be is are was were that this which from as at "
    "its it their such other than under upon each has have had been if then there these those herein hereof "
    "thereof hereby hereto will would".split())


def stem(w: str) -> str:
    if len(w) > 5:
        for suf in _SUFFIXES:
            if w.endswith(suf) and len(w) - len(suf) >= 4:
                return w[: len(w) - len(suf)]
    return w


def tokenize(text: str, stopwords: bool = False) -> list[str]:
    toks = [stem(w) for w in _WORD.findall(text.lower())]
    if stopwords:
        toks = [t for t in toks if t not in STOPWORDS and len(t) > 2]
    return toks


def _tok_all(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return tokenize(text, False)


def _tok_content(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return tokenize(text, True)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ span structure
_NEG = re.compile(r"\b(?:not|no|never|nor|neither|without|except|unless|excluding|prohibit\w*|cannot)\b", re.I)
_MOD = re.compile(r"\b(?:shall|must|will|may|might|can|could|should)\b", re.I)
_LIST = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:\(?[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,4}[\).]|[-*•])\s")
_CONF = re.compile(r"confidential", re.I)
_DEF = re.compile(r"\bmeans?\b|\bincludes?\b", re.I)
STRUCT_COLUMNS = ("log_chars", "n_words", "upper_ratio", "digit_ratio", "heading_like", "ends_colon", "list_marker",
                  "n_negations", "n_modals", "n_confidential", "ends_semicolon_comma", "starts_lowercase",
                  "n_commas_semicolons", "definition_like")


def structure_features(span_texts) -> np.ndarray:
    """(n, 14) array with the columns ``STRUCT_COLUMNS`` for a list of span texts (no context)."""
    n = len(span_texts)
    F = np.zeros((n, len(STRUCT_COLUMNS)))
    for i, t in enumerate(span_texts):
        s = t.strip()
        nt = max(len(s.split()), 1)
        letters = [c for c in s if c.isalpha()]
        F[i] = (np.log1p(len(s)), nt,
                (sum(c.isupper() for c in letters) / len(letters)) if letters else 0.0,
                sum(c.isdigit() for c in s) / max(len(s), 1),
                float(nt <= 10 and not s.endswith((".", ";"))), float(s.endswith(":")), float(bool(_LIST.match(t))),
                len(_NEG.findall(s)), len(_MOD.findall(s)), len(_CONF.findall(s)),
                float(s.endswith((";", ","))), float(s[:1].islower()), s.count(",") + s.count(";"),
                float(bool(_DEF.search(s))))
    return F


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ inputs
def _doc_texts(d: dict) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(d, dict) or "doc_id" not in d:
        raise ValueError("every document must be a dict with a 'doc_id' key (rows of the load_* document tables)")
    if "span_texts" in d:
        return [str(t) for t in d["span_texts"]]
    if "text" in d and "spans" in d:
        return [d["text"][int(a):int(b)] for a, b in d["spans"]]
    raise ValueError(f"document {d['doc_id']!r} needs 'span_texts' (list of span strings) or 'text' + 'spans'")


class _Corpus:
    """Stacked spans of a set of documents: global row index = offset[doc_id] + span index."""

    def __init__(self, documents):
        self.doc_ids: list[str] = []
        self.offset: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.n_spans: dict[str, int] = {}
        texts: list[str] = []
        for d in documents:
            did = str(d["doc_id"])
            if did in self.offset:
                continue
            t = _doc_texts(d)
            self.doc_ids.append(did)
            self.offset[did] = len(texts)
            self.n_spans[did] = len(t)
            texts.extend(t)
        self.texts = texts
        self.n = len(texts)
        self.doc_index = np.concatenate([np.full(self.n_spans[d], k) for k, d in enumerate(self.doc_ids)]) \
            if self.doc_ids else np.zeros(0, int)
        self.pos_in_doc = np.concatenate([np.arange(self.n_spans[d]) for d in self.doc_ids]) if self.doc_ids \
            else np.zeros(0, int)
        self.prev_row = np.where(self.pos_in_doc > 0, np.arange(self.n) - 1, self.n)      # self.n = "zero row"
        last = np.concatenate([np.full(self.n_spans[d], self.n_spans[d] - 1) for d in self.doc_ids]) \
            if self.doc_ids else np.zeros(0, int)
        self.next_row = np.where(self.pos_in_doc < last, np.arange(self.n) + 1, self.n)

    def rows(self, doc_id: str) -> np.ndarray:
        o = self.offset[doc_id]
        return np.arange(o, o + self.n_spans[doc_id])


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ features
def _shift(X, idx, n):
    """Rows of sparse X selected by idx, where idx == n selects an all-zero row."""
    import scipy.sparse as sp
    Xz = sp.vstack([X, sp.csr_matrix((1, X.shape[1]))], format="csr")
    return Xz[idx]


def _hyp_text(h) -> str:
    if isinstance(h, dict):
        return str(h.get("hypothesis", ""))
    return str(h)


class Featurizer:
    """Vocabulary / IDF statistics fitted on the spans of a corpus, then applied to any corpus."""

    def __init__(self, word_ngrams=(1, 2), char_ngrams=(3, 5), min_df=2, max_char_features=60000,
                 bm25_k1=1.5, bm25_b=0.75):
        self.word_ngrams, self.char_ngrams, self.min_df = tuple(word_ngrams), tuple(char_ngrams), int(min_df)
        self.max_char_features, self.k1, self.b = int(max_char_features), float(bm25_k1), float(bm25_b)

    def fit(self, documents) -> "Featurizer":
        from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer, TfidfVectorizer
        corpus = documents if isinstance(documents, _Corpus) else _Corpus(documents)
        t = corpus.texts
        self.word_ = TfidfVectorizer(tokenizer=_tok_all, lowercase=False, token_pattern=None, ngram_range=self.word_ngrams,
                                     min_df=self.min_df, sublinear_tf=True, dtype=np.float32).fit(t)
        self.char_ = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=self.char_ngrams, min_df=3, sublinear_tf=True,
                                     max_features=self.max_char_features, dtype=np.float32).fit(t)
        self.uni_ = TfidfVectorizer(tokenizer=_tok_content, lowercase=False, token_pattern=None, min_df=1,
                                    sublinear_tf=True, dtype=np.float32).fit(t)
        self.count_ = CountVectorizer(tokenizer=_tok_content, lowercase=False, token_pattern=None, dtype=np.float32).fit(t)
        C = self.count_.transform(t)
        df = np.asarray((C > 0).sum(0)).ravel()
        N = C.shape[0]
        self.idf_ = np.log(1.0 + (N - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5))
        self.avgdl_ = max(float(C.sum()) / max(N, 1), 1.0)
        return self

    def transform(self, documents) -> dict:
        corpus = documents if isinstance(documents, _Corpus) else _Corpus(documents)
        t = corpus.texts
        C = self.count_.transform(t).tocsr()
        return {"word": self.word_.transform(t).tocsr(), "char": self.char_.transform(t).tocsr(),
                "uni": self.uni_.transform(t).tocsr(), "count": C,
                "len": np.asarray(C.sum(1)).ravel(), "struct": structure_features(t)}

    def query_scores(self, feats: dict, hypothesis: str) -> dict:
        """Similarity of every span of a transformed corpus to one hypothesis text."""
        q_uni = self.uni_.transform([hypothesis])
        q_char = self.char_.transform([hypothesis])
        cos_uni = np.asarray((feats["uni"] @ q_uni.T).todense()).ravel()
        cos_char = np.asarray((feats["char"] @ q_char.T).todense()).ravel()
        q_cnt = self.count_.transform([hypothesis])
        terms = q_cnt.indices
        C = feats["count"]
        if len(terms):
            tf = C[:, terms].toarray()
            norm = self.k1 * (1 - self.b + self.b * feats["len"] / self.avgdl_)
            bm25 = ((tf * (self.k1 + 1)) / (tf + norm[:, None] + 1e-9) * self.idf_[terms][None, :]).sum(1)
            overlap = (tf > 0).sum(1) / len(terms)
            idf_cov = ((tf > 0) * self.idf_[terms][None, :]).sum(1) / max(self.idf_[terms].sum(), 1e-9)
        else:
            bm25 = np.zeros(C.shape[0]); overlap = bm25; idf_cov = bm25
        return {"cos_uni": cos_uni, "cos_char": cos_char, "bm25": bm25, "overlap": overlap, "idf_cov": idf_cov}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ model
def _rank_pct(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """0 for the highest value of the vector, 1 for the lowest (NaN-safe)."""
    v = np.nan_to_num(np.asarray(v, dtype=float), nan=-1e9)
    r = np.argsort(np.argsort(-v, kind="stable"), kind="stable")
    return r / max(len(v) - 1, 1)


def _norm_annotations(train_annotations, min_evidence=1):
    out = []
    for a in train_annotations:
        lab = a.get("label")
        ev = [int(i) for i in (a.get("evidence_spans") or [])]
        out.append({"doc_id": str(a["doc_id"]), "key": str(a["hypothesis_key"]), "label": lab, "evidence": ev})
    return out


PLM_GROUPS = ("rerank", "nli", "cos", "emb_lr", "emb_knn")


def _plm_groups(plm) -> tuple:
    """``plm`` = False / True (all groups) / an iterable of names from ``PLM_GROUPS``."""
    if plm is None or plm is False:
        return ()
    if plm is True:
        return PLM_GROUPS
    g = tuple(plm)
    bad = [x for x in g if x not in PLM_GROUPS]
    if bad:
        raise ValueError(f"plm groups must be among {PLM_GROUPS}, got {bad}")
    return g


class _PlmTables:
    """Pretrained-model scores of every span of a corpus against a list of hypothesis texts (``scilib.textenc``)."""

    def __init__(self, corpus, hyp_texts, groups):
        from . import textenc
        self.hyp_col = {t: j for j, t in enumerate(hyp_texts)}
        self.rr = self.nli = self.cos = self.emb = None
        if "rerank" in groups:
            self.rr = textenc.relevance(corpus.texts, hyp_texts)
        if "nli" in groups:
            self.nli = textenc.nli(corpus.texts, hyp_texts)
        if "cos" in groups or "emb_lr" in groups or "emb_knn" in groups:
            self.emb = textenc.embed(corpus.texts)
            if "cos" in groups:
                self.cos = self.emb @ textenc.embed(hyp_texts, query=True).T

    def block(self, rows, text):
        """dict of per-span arrays of one hypothesis text for the given corpus rows."""
        j = self.hyp_col[text]
        out = {}
        if self.rr is not None:
            out["rr"] = self.rr[rows, j]
        if self.nli is not None:
            out["nli"] = self.nli[rows, j]
        if self.cos is not None:
            out["cos"] = self.cos[rows, j]
        return out


class ContractModel:
    """Two-stage evidence scorer + label classifier (see the module docstring)."""

    def __init__(self, C: float = 10.0, n_folds: int = 5, context: float = 0.5, char_weight: float = 0.0,
                 stage2: str = "lgbm", use_not_mentioned: bool = False, hyp_id: bool = True, seed: int = 0,
                 n_jobs: int = 2, n_estimators: int = 200, plm=False, emb_C: float = 10.0):
        self.plm = _plm_groups(plm)
        self.emb_C = float(emb_C)
        self.C, self.n_folds, self.context, self.char_weight = float(C), int(n_folds), float(context), float(char_weight)
        self.stage2, self.use_not_mentioned, self.hyp_id = stage2, bool(use_not_mentioned), bool(hyp_id)
        self.seed, self.n_jobs, self.n_estimators = int(seed), int(n_jobs), int(n_estimators)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
    def _design(self, corpus, F):
        import scipy.sparse as sp
        blocks = [F["word"]]
        if self.context:
            blocks += [self.context * _shift(F["word"], corpus.prev_row, corpus.n),
                       self.context * _shift(F["word"], corpus.next_row, corpus.n)]
        if self.char_weight:
            blocks.append(self.char_weight * F["char"])
        return sp.hstack(blocks, format="csr")

    def _fit_lr(self, X, y):
        from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
        if y.sum() == 0 or y.sum() == len(y):
            return None
        return LogisticRegression(C=self.C, class_weight="balanced", solver="liblinear").fit(X, y)

    def _hypothesis_design(self, X, corpus, key):
        # Project hook: scoped sparse query features enter the regularized
        # linear learner, not rare binary columns with a hard tree leaf floor.
        # With no external programs this is exactly the author's design matrix.
        return X

    @staticmethod
    def _lr_score(m, X):
        return m.decision_function(X) if m is not None else np.full(X.shape[0], np.nan)

    def _hyp_index(self, key):
        return self.hyp_ids_.get(key, -1)

    def _pair_block(self, corpus, F, rows, key, s1, qs, knn, pl=None, e1=None, eknn=None):
        """Feature matrix (len(rows), n_feat) of one (document, hypothesis) pair; ``rows`` = the document's rows."""
        st = F["struct"][rows]
        n = len(rows)
        cols, names = [], []

        def add(name, v):
            cols.append(np.asarray(v, dtype=float).reshape(n)); names.append(name)

        def sh(v, k):                       # value of the span k positions before (k>0) / after (k<0), NaN outside
            v = np.asarray(v, dtype=float)
            out = np.full(n, np.nan)
            if k > 0 and n > k:
                out[k:] = v[:-k]
            elif k < 0 and n > -k:
                out[:k] = v[-k:]
            elif k == 0:
                out = v.copy()
            return out

        def add_ranked(name, v):
            v = np.asarray(v, dtype=float)
            top = np.nanmax(v) if np.isfinite(v).any() else 0.0
            add(name, v); add(name + "_rank", _rank_pct(v)); add(name + "_dmax", v - top)

        for nm in ("cos_uni", "cos_char", "bm25", "overlap", "idf_cov"):
            add_ranked(nm, qs[nm][rows])
        add("cos_uni_prev", sh(qs["cos_uni"][rows], 1)); add("cos_uni_next", sh(qs["cos_uni"][rows], -1))
        for j, nm in enumerate(STRUCT_COLUMNS):
            add(nm, st[:, j])
        for j in (4, 5, 6, 10):
            add("prev_" + STRUCT_COLUMNS[j], sh(st[:, j], 1)); add("next_" + STRUCT_COLUMNS[j], sh(st[:, j], -1))
        add("rel_pos", np.arange(n) / max(n - 1, 1))
        add("pos", np.log1p(np.arange(n)))
        add("log_n_spans", np.full(n, np.log(max(n, 1))))
        if "rerank" in self.plm:
            add_ranked("rr", pl["rr"]); add("rr_prev", sh(pl["rr"], 1)); add("rr_next", sh(pl["rr"], -1))
        if "nli" in self.plm:
            lp = pl["nli"]
            add("nli_con", lp[:, 0]); add("nli_ent", lp[:, 1]); add("nli_neu", lp[:, 2])
            add_ranked("nli_ev", np.logaddexp(lp[:, 0], lp[:, 1]))
        if "cos" in self.plm:
            add_ranked("emb_cos", pl["cos"]); add("emb_cos_prev", sh(pl["cos"], 1)); add("emb_cos_next", sh(pl["cos"], -1))
        n_free = len(names)
        if s1 is not None:
            add_ranked("s1", s1)
            for k in (1, -1, 2, -2):
                add(f"s1_sh{k}", sh(s1, k))
        if s1 is not None:
            nan = np.full(n, np.nan)
            add_ranked("knn_max", knn[0] if knn is not None else nan); add("knn_top3", knn[1] if knn is not None else nan)
        if s1 is not None and "emb_lr" in self.plm:
            nan = np.full(n, np.nan)
            e = e1 if e1 is not None else nan
            add_ranked("e1", e); add("e1_prev", sh(e, 1)); add("e1_next", sh(e, -1))
        if s1 is not None and "emb_knn" in self.plm:
            nan = np.full(n, np.nan)
            add_ranked("eknn_max", eknn[0] if eknn is not None else nan); add("eknn_top3", eknn[1] if eknn is not None else nan)
        if self.hyp_id and s1 is not None:
            add("hyp_id", np.full(n, self._hyp_index(key)))
        self.n_free_ = n_free
        self.feature_names_ = names
        return np.column_stack(cols)

    def _knn(self, X_query, key, exclude_docs=None):
        """max and top-3 mean cosine similarity of query rows to the training evidence spans of ``key``."""
        E = self.evi_.get(key)
        if E is None:
            return None
        rows, docs = E
        keep = np.ones(len(rows), bool) if exclude_docs is None else ~np.isin(docs, list(exclude_docs))
        if keep.sum() == 0:
            return None
        S = (X_query @ self.F_["uni"][rows[keep]].T).toarray()
        top = -np.sort(-S, axis=1)[:, :3]
        return S.max(1), top.mean(1)

    def _eknn(self, E_query, key, exclude_docs=None):
        """max and top-3 mean cosine of query span embeddings to the training evidence spans of ``key`` (sentence-encoder space)."""
        ev = self.evi_.get(key)
        if ev is None:
            return None
        rows, docs = ev
        keep = np.ones(len(rows), bool) if exclude_docs is None else ~np.isin(docs, list(exclude_docs))
        if keep.sum() == 0:
            return None
        S = E_query @ self.plm_emb_[rows[keep]].T
        top = -np.sort(-S, axis=1)[:, :3]
        return S.max(1), top.mean(1)

    def _fit_emb_lr(self, E, y):
        from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
        if y.sum() == 0 or y.sum() == len(y):
            return None
        return LogisticRegression(C=self.emb_C, class_weight="balanced", max_iter=300).fit(E, y)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- fit
    def fit(self, train_documents, train_annotations, hypotheses):
        docs = list(train_documents)
        if not docs:
            raise ValueError("train_documents is empty")
        corpus = _Corpus(docs)
        self.corpus_ = corpus
        self.feat_ = Featurizer().fit(corpus)
        F = self.feat_.transform(corpus)
        self.F_ = F
        X1 = self._design(corpus, F)
        self.X1_ = X1
        hyp_text = {str(k): _hyp_text(v) for k, v in dict(hypotheses).items()}
        self.hyp_text_ = hyp_text
        self.hyp_ids_ = {k: i for i, k in enumerate(sorted(hyp_text))}
        ann = [a for a in _norm_annotations(train_annotations) if a["doc_id"] in corpus.offset]
        pairs = [a for a in ann if a["label"] in LABELS and a["evidence"]]
        if not pairs:
            raise ValueError("no annotated Entailment/Contradiction pairs with evidence spans found in train_annotations "
                             "for the given train_documents")
        for a in pairs:
            n_doc = corpus.n_spans[a["doc_id"]]
            if min(a["evidence"]) < 0 or max(a["evidence"]) >= n_doc:
                raise ValueError(f"evidence span index out of range for document {a['doc_id']!r} ({n_doc} spans)")
        self.pairs_ = pairs
        # Project adaptation: the second-stage binary membership model must also
        # see original NotMentioned documents (all spans are negative), not only
        # documents already known to contain evidence. Keep the author's positive
        # pairs for neighbour evidence, stage-one AP and the unused label model.
        scoring_pairs = pairs + [
            {**a, "evidence": []} for a in ann
            if a["label"] == "NotMentioned" and self.use_not_mentioned
        ]
        self.scoring_pairs_ = scoring_pairs
        # evidence rows per hypothesis (for kNN features)
        ev = collections.defaultdict(lambda: ([], []))
        for a in pairs:
            r = corpus.offset[a["doc_id"]] + np.array(a["evidence"], dtype=int)
            ev[a["key"]][0].extend(r.tolist()); ev[a["key"]][1].extend([a["doc_id"]] * len(r))
        self.evi_ = {k: (np.array(v[0]), np.array(v[1])) for k, v in ev.items()}
        # folds by document
        ids = sorted(corpus.doc_ids)
        rng = np.random.default_rng(self.seed)
        perm = rng.permutation(len(ids))
        k_f = max(2, min(self.n_folds, len(ids)))
        fold_of = {ids[j]: int(i % k_f) for i, j in enumerate(perm)}
        self.fold_of_ = fold_of
        by_h = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for a in ann:
            if a["label"] in LABELS and a["evidence"]:
                by_h[a["key"]].append(a)
            elif a["label"] == "NotMentioned" and self.use_not_mentioned:
                by_h[a["key"]].append({**a, "evidence": []})
        self.by_h_ = by_h

        def train_rows(key, exclude_fold=None):
            rr, yy = [], []
            for a in by_h[key]:
                if exclude_fold is not None and fold_of[a["doc_id"]] == exclude_fold:
                    continue
                r = corpus.rows(a["doc_id"])
                rr.append(r); yy.append(gold_vector(len(r), a["evidence"]))
            if not rr:
                return None, None
            return np.concatenate(rr), np.concatenate(yy)

        self.plm_tabs_, self.plm_emb_ = None, None
        if self.plm:
            texts = sorted(set(hyp_text.values()) | {hyp_text.get(a["key"], "") for a in pairs})
            self.plm_tabs_ = _PlmTables(corpus, texts, self.plm)
            self.plm_emb_ = self.plm_tabs_.emb
        # stage 1: per-hypothesis linear models (final + out-of-fold scores of the training pairs)
        self.lr_ = {}
        self.elr_ = {}
        oof = {}                                   # (doc, key) -> scores
        oof_e = {}
        for key in by_h:
            r, y = train_rows(key)
            if r is not None:
                self.lr_[key] = self._fit_lr(X1[r], y)
                if "emb_lr" in self.plm:
                    self.elr_[key] = self._fit_emb_lr(self.plm_emb_[r], y)
            for f in range(k_f):
                tgt = [a for a in scoring_pairs if a["key"] == key and fold_of[a["doc_id"]] == f]
                if not tgt:
                    continue
                r, y = train_rows(key, f)
                m = self._fit_lr(X1[r], y) if r is not None else None
                me = self._fit_emb_lr(self.plm_emb_[r], y) if (r is not None and "emb_lr" in self.plm) else None
                for a in tgt:
                    rr_ = corpus.rows(a["doc_id"])
                    oof[(a["doc_id"], key)] = self._lr_score(m, X1[rr_])
                    if "emb_lr" in self.plm:
                        oof_e[(a["doc_id"], key)] = me.decision_function(self.plm_emb_[rr_]) if me is not None else None
        self.oof_s1_ = oof
        by_key_ap = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for a in pairs:
            o = oof[(a["doc_id"], a["key"])]
            if np.isfinite(o).all():
                by_key_ap[a["key"]].append(average_precision(gold_vector(len(o), a["evidence"]), o))
        self.stage1_oof_map_ = {k: float(np.mean(v)) for k, v in sorted(by_key_ap.items())}
        # stage 2 training matrix
        qs_cache = {}
        Xs, ys, Xs_free, groups = [], [], [], []
        for a in scoring_pairs:
            key = a["key"]
            if key not in qs_cache:
                qs_cache[key] = self.feat_.query_scores(F, hyp_text.get(key, ""))
            rows = corpus.rows(a["doc_id"])
            s1 = oof[(a["doc_id"], key)]
            knn = self._knn(F["uni"][rows], key, exclude_docs=[d for d in set(self.evi_.get(key, ([], []))[1])
                                                               if fold_of[d] == fold_of[a["doc_id"]]]) if key in self.evi_ else None
            pl = self.plm_tabs_.block(rows, hyp_text.get(key, "")) if self.plm else None
            eknn = None
            if "emb_knn" in self.plm and key in self.evi_:
                eknn = self._eknn(self.plm_emb_[rows], key, exclude_docs=[d for d in set(self.evi_[key][1])
                                                                          if fold_of[d] == fold_of[a["doc_id"]]])
            Xs.append(self._pair_block(corpus, F, rows, key, s1, qs_cache[key], knn, pl, oof_e.get((a["doc_id"], key)), eknn))
            ys.append(gold_vector(len(rows), a["evidence"]))
            groups.append(np.full(len(rows), len(groups)))
        self.qs_train_ = qs_cache
        ev_texts = [" ".join(corpus.texts[corpus.offset[a["doc_id"]] + i] for i in a["evidence"]) for a in pairs]
        self.label_model_ = LabelModel().fit(ev_texts, [a["key"] for a in pairs], [a["label"] for a in pairs])
        self.n_full_ = Xs[0].shape[1] if Xs else 0
        if not Xs:
            self.m2_ = None
            return self
        X = np.vstack(Xs); y = np.concatenate(ys)
        self.m2_ = self._fit_stage2(X, y, None)
        self.m2_free_ = self._fit_stage2(X[:, : self.n_free_], y, None)
        return self

    def _fit_stage2(self, X, y, groups):
        import lightgbm as lgb
        m = lgb.LGBMClassifier(n_estimators=self.n_estimators, learning_rate=0.05, num_leaves=15, min_child_samples=20,
                               subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.8, reg_lambda=1.0,
                               n_jobs=self.n_jobs, random_state=self.seed, verbose=-1, deterministic=True,
                               force_row_wise=True)
        m.fit(X, y)
        return m

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- predict
    def _check_items(self, items, corpus):
        for i, it in enumerate(items):
            if "hypothesis_key" not in it or "doc_id" not in it:
                raise ValueError(f"item {i} needs 'doc_id' and 'hypothesis_key' (rows of the load_* item tables)")
            did = str(it["doc_id"])
            if did not in corpus.offset:
                raise ValueError(f"item {i}: doc_id {did!r} is not among the documents passed to predict")
            if it.get("n_spans") is not None and int(it["n_spans"]) != corpus.n_spans[did]:
                raise ValueError(f"item {i}: n_spans={it['n_spans']} but document {did!r} has {corpus.n_spans[did]} spans")
            key = str(it["hypothesis_key"])
            if not it.get("hypothesis") and key not in self.hyp_text_:
                raise ValueError(f"item {i}: hypothesis_key {key!r} is unknown and the item has no 'hypothesis' text")

    def predict_scores(self, items, documents):
        if getattr(self, "m2_", None) is None and not hasattr(self, "lr_"):
            raise RuntimeError("call fit(...) before predict")
        corpus = _Corpus(documents)
        items = list(items)
        self._check_items(items, corpus)
        F = self.feat_.transform(corpus)
        X1 = self._design(corpus, F)
        qs_cache = {}
        out = []
        item_text = [_hyp_text(it.get("hypothesis")) if it.get("hypothesis") else self.hyp_text_.get(str(it["hypothesis_key"]), "")
                     for it in items]
        tabs = _PlmTables(corpus, sorted(set(item_text)), self.plm) if (self.plm and items) else None
        for it, text in zip(items, item_text):
            key, did = str(it["hypothesis_key"]), str(it["doc_id"])
            ck = (key, text)
            if ck not in qs_cache:
                qs_cache[ck] = self.feat_.query_scores(F, text)
            rows = corpus.rows(did)
            m1 = self.lr_.get(key)
            if m1 is not None and self.m2_ is not None:
                s1 = self._lr_score(m1, self._hypothesis_design(X1, corpus, key)[rows])
                knn = self._knn(F["uni"][rows], key)
                pl = tabs.block(rows, text) if tabs is not None else None
                e1 = None
                if "emb_lr" in self.plm and self.elr_.get(key) is not None:
                    e1 = self.elr_[key].decision_function(tabs.emb[rows])
                eknn = self._eknn(tabs.emb[rows], key) if "emb_knn" in self.plm else None
                Xp = self._pair_block(corpus, F, rows, key, s1, qs_cache[ck], knn, pl, e1, eknn)
                sc = self.m2_.predict_proba(Xp)[:, 1]
            else:
                pl = tabs.block(rows, text) if tabs is not None else None
                Xp = self._pair_block(corpus, F, rows, key, None, qs_cache[ck], None, pl)
                sc = self.m2_free_.predict_proba(Xp)[:, 1] if getattr(self, "m2_free_", None) is not None \
                    else qs_cache[ck]["overlap"][rows]
            out.append(sc)
        return out

    def predict(self, items, documents):
        scores = self.predict_scores(items, documents)
        texts = {str(d["doc_id"]): _doc_texts(d) for d in documents}
        out = []
        lm = getattr(self, "label_model_", None)
        for it, s in zip(items, scores):
            lab = "Entailment"
            if lm is not None and len(s):
                order = np.argsort(-s)
                top = [j for j in order[: lm.top_k] if s[j] >= lm.rel_threshold * s[order[0]]]
                lab = lm.predict(str(it["hypothesis_key"]), " ".join(texts[str(it["doc_id"])][j] for j in sorted(top)))
            out.append({"label": lab, "span_scores": [float(v) for v in np.clip(s, 0.0, 1.0)]})
        return out


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ labels
_LABEL_CUES = ("not", "no", "never", "without", "except", "unless", "other than", "whether or not", "regardless",
               "provided", "however", "notwithstanding", "only", "solely", "any", "all", "may", "shall")


def _cue_counts(text: str) -> list[float]:
    t = " " + text.lower() + " "
    return [float(len(re.findall(r"\b" + re.escape(c) + r"\b", t))) for c in _LABEL_CUES]


class LabelModel:
    """Entailment vs Contradiction from the text of the evidence spans, one logistic regression per hypothesis
    (word 1-3-gram TF-IDF + cue-word counts); a hypothesis whose training pairs have a single label (or fewer than
    ``min_minority`` of the rarer label) always gets its majority label."""

    def __init__(self, C: float = 3.0, min_minority: int = 3, top_k: int = 2, rel_threshold: float = 0.5):
        self.C, self.min_minority, self.top_k, self.rel_threshold = float(C), int(min_minority), int(top_k), float(rel_threshold)

    def fit(self, evidence_texts, keys, labels):
        from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
        from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
        import scipy.sparse as sp
        self.prior_ = collections.Counter(labels)
        self.by_key_ = {}
        idx = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for i, k in enumerate(keys):
            idx[k].append(i)
        self.majority_ = {}
        self.models_ = {}
        for k, ii in idx.items():
            y = np.array([1 if labels[i] == "Contradiction" else 0 for i in ii])
            self.majority_[k] = "Contradiction" if y.sum() * 2 > len(y) else "Entailment"
            if min(y.sum(), len(y) - y.sum()) < self.min_minority:
                continue
            tx = [evidence_texts[i] for i in ii]
            vec = TfidfVectorizer(tokenizer=_tok_all, lowercase=False, token_pattern=None, ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=1,
                                  sublinear_tf=True).fit(tx)
            X = sp.hstack([vec.transform(tx), sp.csr_matrix(np.log1p([_cue_counts(t) for t in tx]))], format="csr")
            self.models_[k] = (vec, LogisticRegression(C=self.C, class_weight="balanced", solver="liblinear").fit(X, y))
        return self

    def predict_proba_contradiction(self, key, text) -> float:
        import scipy.sparse as sp
        if key in self.models_:
            vec, m = self.models_[key]
            X = sp.hstack([vec.transform([text]), sp.csr_matrix(np.log1p([_cue_counts(text)]))], format="csr")
            return float(m.predict_proba(X)[0, 1])
        maj = self.majority_.get(key)
        if maj is None:
            maj = "Contradiction" if self.prior_["Contradiction"] > self.prior_["Entailment"] else "Entailment"
        return 1.0 if maj == "Contradiction" else 0.0

    def predict(self, key, text) -> str:
        return "Contradiction" if self.predict_proba_contradiction(key, text) > 0.5 else "Entailment"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ evaluation helpers
def evidence_map(gold_list, score_list) -> float:
    """Mean over pairs of ``average_precision(gold, scores)`` (the per-pair aggregation of the task metric)."""
    return float(np.mean([average_precision(g, s) for g, s in zip(gold_list, score_list)]))


def evaluate_predictions(predictions, gold_list, labels=None) -> dict:
    """Metrics of ``predictions`` ([{'label', 'span_scores'}]) against ``gold_list`` (0/1 span vectors, one per pair) and
    optionally ``labels`` ('Entailment' | 'Contradiction'): ``map``, ``p_at_r80`` (mean official precision at 80 % recall,
    pairs without gold spans skipped), ``nli_binary_accuracy`` (only when ``labels`` is given), ``aps`` (per pair)."""
    if len(predictions) != len(gold_list):
        raise ValueError(f"{len(predictions)} predictions for {len(gold_list)} gold vectors")
    aps = [average_precision(g, p["span_scores"]) for g, p in zip(gold_list, predictions)]
    pr = [precision_at_recall(g, p["span_scores"], 0.8) for g, p in zip(gold_list, predictions)]
    out = {"map": float(np.mean(aps)), "p_at_r80": float(np.nanmean(pr)), "aps": aps}
    if labels is not None:
        out["nli_binary_accuracy"] = float(np.mean([p.get("label") == l for p, l in zip(predictions, labels)]))
    return out


def annotation_pairs(train_documents, train_annotations):
    """Labelled (document, hypothesis) pairs of the training annotations that have a gold Entailment / Contradiction label
    and at least one evidence span: returns ``(items, gold_list, labels)`` with ``items`` = dicts (doc_id, hypothesis_key,
    n_spans), ``gold_list`` = 0/1 span vectors, ``labels`` = label strings."""
    n = {str(d["doc_id"]): len(_doc_texts(d)) for d in train_documents}
    items, gold, labels = [], [], []
    for a in _norm_annotations(train_annotations):
        if a["label"] in LABELS and a["evidence"] and a["doc_id"] in n:
            items.append({"doc_id": a["doc_id"], "hypothesis_key": a["key"], "n_spans": n[a["doc_id"]]})
            gold.append(gold_vector(n[a["doc_id"]], a["evidence"])); labels.append(a["label"])
    return items, gold, labels


def cross_validate(train_documents, train_annotations, hypotheses, n_folds: int = 3, seed: int = 0, **model_kwargs) -> dict:
    """Document-grouped cross-validation of the whole pipeline on the annotated training contracts: every fold is fitted
    on the other contracts and predicts the labelled pairs of the held-out ones. Returns ``evaluate_predictions`` output
    plus ``n_pairs`` and ``per_hypothesis_map``."""
    items, gold, labels = annotation_pairs(train_documents, train_annotations)
    docs = {str(d["doc_id"]): d for d in train_documents}
    ids = sorted({it["doc_id"] for it in items})
    if len(ids) < 2:
        raise ValueError("cross_validate needs labelled pairs in at least 2 contracts")
    k = max(2, min(int(n_folds), len(ids)))
    perm = np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(len(ids))
    fold = {ids[j]: i % k for i, j in enumerate(perm)}
    preds = [None] * len(items)
    for f in range(k):
        tr_docs = [d for i, d in docs.items() if fold.get(i, -1) != f]
        tr_ids = {str(d["doc_id"]) for d in tr_docs}
        ann = [a for a in train_annotations if str(a["doc_id"]) in tr_ids]
        te = [j for j, it in enumerate(items) if fold[it["doc_id"]] == f]
        model = ContractModel(seed=seed, **model_kwargs).fit(tr_docs, ann, hypotheses)
        out = model.predict([items[j] for j in te], [docs[i] for i in sorted({items[j]["doc_id"] for j in te})])
        for j, p in zip(te, out):
            preds[j] = p
    res = evaluate_predictions(preds, gold, labels)
    by_h = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for it, ap in zip(items, res["aps"]):
        by_h[it["hypothesis_key"]].append(ap)
    res["per_hypothesis_map"] = {k_: float(np.mean(v)) for k_, v in sorted(by_h.items())}
    res["n_pairs"] = len(items)
    return res


def fit_predict(train_documents, train_annotations, hypotheses, items, documents, seed: int = 0, n_jobs: int = 2,
                **model_kwargs) -> list[dict]:
    """``ContractModel(...).fit(...).predict(items, documents)``: one ``{'label', 'span_scores'}`` dict per item."""
    return ContractModel(seed=seed, n_jobs=n_jobs, **model_kwargs).fit(
        train_documents, train_annotations, hypotheses).predict(items, documents)

def task_local_kind(cfg):
    views = (cfg.get("candidate_source_view"), cfg.get("teacher_feedback_view"))
    writer = (cfg.get("teacher_publication_format"), cfg.get("skill_delivery_encoding"))
    literal = ("literal_original_span_v1", "literal_evidence_comparisons_v1")
    if writer == ("explicit_witness_accounts_v2", "scoped_lossless_table_v1") and views == literal:
        return "witness_table"
    if writer == ("source_acquisition_programs_v1", "named_source_programs_v1") and views == literal:
        return "source_programs"
    if writer != (None, None):
        raise ValueError("Unknown or incomplete declared task-local writer/delivery format")
    if views == literal:
        return "literal"
    if views == (None, None):
        return "task_local"
    raise ValueError("Unknown or incomplete declared task-local source/feedback views")


def study_for(config, run_id):
    cfg = read(config)
    method = cfg.get("method", "callable")
    if method == "task_local_memory":
        kind = task_local_kind(cfg)
        if kind == "source_programs":
            from legal_skill_guard.learning.source_programs import SourceProgramStudy

            return SourceProgramStudy(config, run_id=run_id)
        if kind == "witness_table":
            from legal_skill_guard.learning.witness_grounding import WitnessGroundedStudy

            return WitnessGroundedStudy(config, run_id=run_id)
        if kind == "literal":
            from legal_skill_guard.learning.literal_evidence import LiteralEvidenceStudy

            return LiteralEvidenceStudy(config, run_id=run_id)
        from legal_skill_guard.learning.task_local import TaskLocalStudy

        return TaskLocalStudy(config, run_id=run_id)
    if method == "source_conditioned_memory":
        from legal_skill_guard.learning.conditioned import ConditionedCompletion, ConditionedStudy

        if read(config).get("continuation_parent"):
            return ConditionedCompletion(config, run_id=run_id)
        return ConditionedStudy(config, run_id=run_id)
    if method == "trace_procedural_memory":
        from legal_skill_guard.learning.procedures import ProcedureStudy

        return ProcedureStudy(config, run_id=run_id)
    if method == "evidence_programs":
        from legal_skill_guard.learning.operators import OperatorStudy

        return OperatorStudy(config, run_id=run_id)
    if method in ("answer_review", "source_check_execution"):
        from legal_skill_guard.learning.review import ReviewStudy

        return ReviewStudy(config, run_id=run_id)
    if method != "callable":
        raise ValueError("Unknown declared learning method")
    return Comparison(config, run_id=run_id)


def prepare(config):
    cfg = read(config)
    frozen = config.with_suffix(".frozen.json")
    if frozen.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Already frozen; use a new config for any change")
    reference_paths = []
    if cfg.get("method") == "task_local_memory":
        from legal_skill_guard.learning.task_local import prepare_task_local_inputs

        task_local_kind(cfg)  # Reject unsupported/half-declared formats before writes.
        selection, reference_paths = prepare_task_local_inputs(cfg)
    elif cfg.get("method") == "source_conditioned_memory":
        from legal_skill_guard.learning.conditioned import prepare_conditioned_inputs

        selection, reference_paths = prepare_conditioned_inputs(cfg)
    elif cfg.get("method") in ("evidence_programs", "trace_procedural_memory"):
        from legal_skill_guard.learning.operators import prepare_operator_packets

        selection = prepare_operator_packets(ROOT, cfg)
    elif cfg.get("method", "callable") in ("answer_review", "source_check_execution"):
        from legal_skill_guard.learning.review import prepare_review_packets

        selection = prepare_review_packets(ROOT, cfg)
    elif cfg.get("method", "callable") == "callable":
        selection = prepare_packets(ROOT, cfg)
    else:
        raise ValueError("Unknown declared learning method")
    pid = cfg["model_process_pid"]  # Explicit identity; never discover/substitute another.
    proc = Path("/proc") / str(pid)
    argv = [v.decode() for v in (proc / "cmdline").read_bytes().split(b"\0") if v]
    if not any("Qwen3-8B" in v for v in argv) or "--served-model-name" not in argv:
        raise RuntimeError("Original frozen 8B process identity unavailable")
    environment = {
        "at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        "pid": pid,
        "actual_argv": argv,
        "process_start_ticks": (proc / "stat").read_text().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()[19],
        "model_on_disk_missing_after_incident": True,
        "same_live_loaded_model_not_restarted_or_redownloaded": True,
        "weight_file_sha256_not_recovered": True,
        "tokenizer_access": "same serving vLLM /tokenize; no local substitute",
        "environment_reconstruction_not_bitwise_historical_environment": True,
    }
    RunStore.immutable_json(ROOT / cfg["inference_environment"], environment)
    ledger = ROOT / cfg["teacher"]["ledger"]
    if not ledger.exists():
        RunStore.immutable_json(
            ledger,
            {
                "schema_version": 2,
                "model": cfg["teacher"]["model"],
                "max_invocations": cfg["teacher"]["total_invocation_budget"],
                "historical_count_lower_bound": 1225,
                "reservations": [],
                "historical_reservation_records_missing": True,
                "lower_bound_basis": "1190 reservations before Oct14 main + at least35 main teacher attempts before deletion; raw prefix lost",
                "count_is_not_an_exact_recovery_of_historical_usage": True,
                "new_reservations_only_no_fabricated_historical_records": True,
            },
        )
    paths = sorted((ROOT / "legal_skill_guard").rglob("*.py"))
    paths += sorted(
        p
        for p in (ROOT / "legal_skill_guard/_vendor").iterdir()
        if p.is_file() and p.suffix in (".md", ".txt")
    )
    paths += sorted((ROOT / "third_party").rglob("*.py"))
    paths += sorted(
        p
        for p in (ROOT / "third_party").rglob("*")
        if p.is_file() and (p.suffix in (".txt", ".md") or p.name == "LICENSE")
    )
    paths += [
        config,
        ROOT / cfg["input_packet"],
        ROOT / cfg["grading_only"],
        ROOT / cfg["preselection"],
        ROOT / cfg["inference_environment"],
        ROOT / "pyproject.toml",
        ROOT / "uv.lock",
        ROOT / "docs/METHOD_AND_PROTOCOL.md",
    ]
    if "method_protocol" in cfg:
        paths.append(ROOT / cfg["method_protocol"])
    if "input_budget_evidence" in cfg:
        paths.append(ROOT / cfg["input_budget_evidence"])
    paths += reference_paths
    RunStore.immutable_json(
        frozen,
        {
            "at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            "config_sha256": sha(config),
            "files": {str(p.resolve()): sha(p) for p in sorted(set(paths))},
            "mutable_ledgers_logs_and_status_not_bound": True,
        },
    )
    return {
        "frozen": str(frozen),
        "train_sources": len(selection["training_ids"]),
        "future_sources": len(selection["future_ids"]),
        "model_calls": 0,
        "teacher_calls": 0,
    }


def verify_learning(study):
    """One actual experience update; a reconstruction check, not method evidence."""
    study.cfg = {**study.cfg, "planned_new_native_calls": 2, "planned_new_teacher_calls": 1}
    study.training = study.training[:1]
    study.future = []
    study.current_batch = 1
    study.check()
    RunStore.immutable_json(
        study.out / "declaration.json",
        {
            "at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            "run_id": study.run_id,
            "purpose": "engineering_reconstruction_one_seen_document_only",
            "not_a_method_comparison_or_paper_metric": True,
            "gold_is_training_feedback_only": True,
            "config_overrides": {
                "planned_native": 2,
                "planned_teacher": 1,
                "training_ids": [study.training[0]["id"]],
            },
            "original_config": study.cfg,
            "frozen_bindings": study.bindings,
        },
    )
    RunStore.immutable_json(study.out / "launch.json", {"pid": os.getpid(), "argv": sys.argv})
    row = study.training[0]
    before = study.collect("reconstruction_before", "experience", [row], [])
    study.before["experience"][row["id"]] = before
    bank = study.update_callable("experience", 1)
    after = study.collect("reconstruction_after", "experience", [row], bank)
    from legal_skill_guard.learning.audit import close, original_score

    for u in before + after:
        expected = original_score(
            u["response"], row, row["annotation_sets"][0]["annotations"], list(study.labels)
        )
        close(expected, {k: u[k] for k in expected})
    value = {
        "at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        "purpose": "engineering_reconstruction_only",
        "native_calls": len(study.native),
        "teacher_calls": len(study.teachers),
        "actual_document_id": row["id"],
        "before_public_valid": before[0]["public_valid"],
        "after_public_valid": after[0]["public_valid"],
        "published_skill_count": len(bank),
        "actual_original_feedback_reaches_teacher_and_publication_reaches_lawyer": True,
        "independent_score_agrees": True,
        "not_evidence_of_learning_generalization": True,
    }
    RunStore.immutable_json(study.out / "engineering_completion.json", value)
    RunStore.atomic_json(study.out / "progress.json", {"state": "completed", **value})
    return value


def worker(config, run_id, engineering):
    lock = ROOT / "artifacts/gpu_generation.lock"
    lock.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with lock.open("a+") as stream:
        fcntl.flock(stream.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        study = study_for(config, run_id)
        try:
            if engineering:
                if read(config).get("method") in (
                    "answer_review",
                    "source_check_execution",
                    "evidence_programs",
                    "trace_procedural_memory",
                    "source_conditioned_memory",
                    "task_local_memory",
                ):
                    raise ValueError("No extra pre-training qualification for declared skill study")
                return verify_learning(study)
            study.execute()
            return write_report(study.out)
        except BaseException as exc:
            value = {
                "at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                "run_id": run_id,
                "error": repr(exc),
                "completed_native_calls": len(study.native),
                "completed_teacher_calls": len(study.teachers),
                "teacher_attempts": study.teacher_attempts,
                "current_batch": study.current_batch,
                "no_silent_resume_or_fallback": True,
            }
            RunStore.immutable_json(study.out / "failure.json", value)
            RunStore.atomic_json(
                study.out / "progress.json",
                {"state": "stopped" if isinstance(exc, InterruptedError) else "failed", **value},
            )
            raise


def launch(config, run_id, engineering):
    # Launch lock prevents two requests creating two workers for the same Run ID.
    root = ROOT / "artifacts/launches"
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (root / "launch.lock").open("a+") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        record = root / (run_id + ".json")
        if record.exists() or (ROOT / "runs" / run_id).exists():
            raise FileExistsError("Existing Run ID; never overwrite or restart it")
        if engineering and read(config).get("method") in (
            "answer_review",
            "source_check_execution",
            "evidence_programs",
            "trace_procedural_memory",
            "source_conditioned_memory",
            "task_local_memory",
        ):
            raise ValueError("Start the declared skill study directly, not extra qualification")
        probe = study_for(config, run_id)
        probe.check()
        argv = [
            str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/python"),
            "-m",
            "legal_skill_guard.cli",
            "worker",
            "--config",
            str(config),
            "--run-id",
            run_id,
        ]
        if engineering:
            argv.append("--engineering")
        with (root / (run_id + ".log")).open("xb") as log:
            process = subprocess.Popen(
                argv,
                cwd=ROOT,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                start_new_session=True,
                env={**os.environ, "PYTHONUNBUFFERED": "1"},
            )
        value = {
            "at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            "run_id": run_id,
            "pid": process.pid,
            "actual_argv": argv,
            "background_independent_of_conversation": True,
            "engineering_only": engineering,
            "log": str(root / (run_id + ".log")),
        }
        RunStore.immutable_json(record, value)
        return value


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=["prepare", "launch", "worker", "status", "report"])
    parser.add_argument(
        "--config",
        type=Path,
        default=ROOT / "configs/contractnli_source_programs.json",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--run-id")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--engineering",
        action="store_true",
        help="one-document real-chain reconstruction check only",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = args.config.resolve()
    run_id = safe_component(args.run_id or read(config)["run_id"])
    if args.command == "prepare":
        value = prepare(config)
    elif args.command == "launch":
        value = launch(config, run_id, args.engineering)
    elif args.command == "worker":
        value = worker(config, run_id, args.engineering)
    elif args.command == "report":
        value = write_report(ROOT / "runs" / run_id)
    else:
        run = ROOT / "runs" / run_id
        value = (
            read(run / "progress.json")
            if (run / "progress.json").is_file()
            else {"state": "not_started", "run_id": run_id}
        )
    print(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def source_components(documents):
    parent = {r["id"]: r["id"] for r in documents}

    def find(i):
        while parent[i] != i:
            parent[i] = parent[parent[i]]
            i = parent[i]
        return i

    def union(a, b):
        a, b = find(a), find(b)
        if a != b:
            parent[max(a, b)] = min(a, b)

    urls, texts = {}, {}
    for row in documents:
        if row["url"]:
            if row["url"] in urls:
                union(row["id"], urls[row["url"]])
            else:
                urls[row["url"]] = row["id"]
        key = " ".join(re.findall(r"\w+", unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", row["text"]).casefold()))
        if key in texts:
            union(row["id"], texts[key])
        else:
            texts[key] = row["id"]
    groups = {}
    for i in parent:
        groups.setdefault(find(i), []).append(i)
    return [sorted(g) for g in groups.values()]


def prepare_packets(root: Path, cfg: dict):
    archive = root / cfg["source_archive"]
    checksum = hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if checksum != cfg["source_archive_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Pinned dataset archive bytes differ")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
        original = json.loads(z.read("contract-nli/train.json"))
    docs = {r["id"]: r for r in original["documents"]}
    groups = source_components(original["documents"])
    ranked = sorted(
        (g for g in groups if 382 not in g),
        key=lambda g: hashlib.sha256(
            ("contractnli_bounded_learning_v1:" + ",".join(map(str, g))).encode()
        ).hexdigest(),
    )
    a, b = cfg["train_component_ranks"]
    c, d = cfg["future_component_ranks"]
    train_groups, future_groups = ranked[a:b], ranked[c:d]
    training = [{**docs[i], "batch": j // 4 + 1} for j, g in enumerate(train_groups) for i in g]
    future_ids = [i for g in future_groups for i in g]
    if [r["id"] for r in training] != TRAIN_IDS or future_ids != FUTURE_IDS:
        raise ValueError("Exact historical metadata selection did not reconstruct")
    if len(original["labels"]) != 17 or len(future_groups) != 24:
        raise ValueError("Original task/source group cardinality differs")
    packet = {
        "public_hypotheses": original["labels"],
        "training": training,
        "development_inputs_no_annotation_sets": [
            {k: v for k, v in docs[i].items() if k != "annotation_sets"} for i in future_ids
        ],
        "development_component_groups": future_groups,
    }
    RunStore.immutable_json(root / cfg["input_packet"], packet)
    RunStore.immutable_json(
        root / cfg["grading_only"],
        {
            "annotations": {
                str(i): docs[i]["annotation_sets"][0]["annotations"] for i in future_ids
            },
            "never_to_solver_or_teacher": True,
            "read_only_after_all_six_future_conditions_finish": True,
        },
    )
    preselection = {
        "source_archive_sha256": checksum,
        "source_archive_url": cfg["source_archive_url"],
        "read_members": ["contract-nli/train.json"],
        "train_component_ranks_half_open": [a, b],
        "future_component_ranks_half_open": [c, d],
        "training_ids": TRAIN_IDS,
        "future_ids": FUTURE_IDS,
        "train_component_groups": train_groups,
        "future_component_groups": future_groups,
        "rank_rule": "SHA256(contractnli_bounded_learning_v1:ordered IDs), excluding component382",
        "component_rule": "same nonempty URL or normalized complete text, transitive union",
        "official_dev_test_opened": False,
        "old_raw_runs_and_historical_libraries_recovered": False,
        "reconstruction_from_original_data_not_new_generation": True,
    }
    RunStore.immutable_json(root / cfg["preselection"], preselection)
    return preselection

"""Auditable structured-output adapter for a ChatGPT-authenticated Codex CLI.

Codex runs in an empty temporary working directory. Tool-use events make the call
invalid. Persistent caches contain response payloads and hashes, never hidden prompts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import fcntl
import json
import os

import signal

import sys

import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from contextlib import suppress
from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
